dropped.item: The water saving was bigger than expected
The change helps the plant keep up with demand without the same strain on resources
The night shift team did this work often while most of us are asleep
The commitment that 'we'll keep looking for ways to improve'
The work takes people who care about getting it right (the emphasis on care and getting it right)
Linen goes 'back on the ward' (the specific hospital-ward destination)

changed.item: 'It helps with running costs' became the vaguer 'to our business'
The original's firm 'For a site this size, that matters' became 'It might not sound like much, but... can make a big difference', which adds self-deprecating framing and hedges the claim with 'can'

'None of this happens just because a machine arrives' (about the water and efficiency results) became 'our quality of service doesn't just come from our machinery', which shifts the scope to service quality
'The results we're seeing are down to you' (full credit to the team) became 'We wouldn't have achieved the results we have without you' (contributory credit)
Night shift 'adapted to new equipment, new routines and new ways of working' became 'worked with us to change the way we work', which recasts them as collaborators in driving the change

added.item: 'It might not sound like much' framing
Clean laundry is returned 'to our customers' (customer framing not in original)
